Realme · Oppo · OnePlus
Vivo · iQOO
Xiaomi · Redmi · Poco
Other
Steps for %1$s
Settings → Apps → SMS Forwarder → Battery → choose **Unrestricted**.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → **Never sleeping apps** → **+** → add SMS Forwarder.
On the same screen turn **off** \"Put unused apps to sleep\" and \"Auto-disable unused apps\".
Reboot once, then tick Done.
Settings → Apps → App management → SMS Forwarder → **Battery usage** → turn on **Allow auto launch** and **Allow background activity**, choose **Unrestricted**.
Settings → Battery → **More settings** → turn off \"Sleep standby optimisation\" / \"Optimise battery use\" for this app.
Older phones: Phone Manager → Privacy permissions → **Startup manager** → allow SMS Forwarder.
Recent apps → long-press SMS Forwarder → **Lock** (optional). Tick Done.
Settings → Apps → SMS Forwarder → Battery → **Unrestricted** (or Allow background activity).
i Manager → App manager → **Autostart manager** → allow SMS Forwarder.
Settings → Battery → **Background power consumption management** → SMS Forwarder → **Allow high background power consumption**.
Tick Done.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → SMS Forwarder → **Autostart** on.
Same page → **Battery saver** → **No restrictions**.
Recent apps → long-press SMS Forwarder → **Lock**. Tick Done.
Settings → Apps → SMS Forwarder → Battery → **Unrestricted**.
Settings → Battery → turn off any \"Adaptive\" / \"Optimise\" limits for SMS Forwarder.
Tick Done.
